Right — the first packet errors out (UNKNOWN) and terminates, so the rest are trivially dropped. That's why it's fast. To stress the happy path, let me remove the UNKNOWN and make all packets valid with real work (stores, overlaps).

Let me build a "happy path max" test: 20000 packets each with 3 frames doing real stores at overlapping offsets with overlap='reject' (forcing conflict checks), 60000 frames, ~2 MiB data, plus streams.

Note: with overlap='reject' and identical retransmissions, the conflict check compares runs — good stress.

Let me do that.

cd /app/work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, random, subprocess, sys, time, resource, collections
random.seed(9)
events=[{'t':0,'op':'key','level':'H','action':'install'},{'t':0,'op':'key','level':'A','action':'install'},
        {'t':0,'op':'key','level':'I','action':'install'}]
ev=3; pk=0; fr=0; data=0
for i in range(1250):
    pkts=[]
    for j in range(16):
        lvl = 'A' if j==15 else ('H' if j%2 else 'I')
        frames=[{'type':'STREAM','id':(j%64)*4,'offset':(j*37)%40000,'data_hex':'ab'*34,'fin':False},
                {'type':'CRYPTO','offset':(j*53)%40000,'data_hex':'cd'*34},
                {'type':'ACK','ranges':[[0,4611686018427387903]]}]
        fr+=3; data+=68
        pkts.append({'level':lvl,'pn':pk,'auth':True,'frames':frames}); pk+=1
    events.append({'t':i+1,'op':'datagram','bytes':1200,'packets':pkts}); ev+=1
while ev<20000:
    events.append({'t':ev,'op':'tick'}); ev+=1
traces=[{'id':'t','config':{'early':False,'overlap':'reject','buffer_packets':1024,'idle_ms':0,
  'max_streams_bidi':1024,'max_streams_uni':1024,'max_stream_data':65536,'max_data':4611686018427387903,
  'crypto_limit':65536,'sent':{'I':[[0,4611686018427387903]],'H':[[0,4611686018427387903]],'A':[[0,4611686018427387903]]}},'events':events}]
req=json.dumps({'version':1,'traces':traces}).encode()
print('counts ev',ev,'pk',pk,'fr',fr,'data',data,'size MB',round(len(req)/1e6,2))
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/app/submission/entry.py'],input=req,capture_output=True,cwd='/app/submission')
u=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('rc',p.returncode,'wall %.2f cpu %.2f rss %.1fMB out %.1fMB'%(time.time()-t0,u.ru_utime,u.ru_maxrss/1024,len(p.stdout)/1e6))
d=json.loads(p.stdout)['results'][0]
print(collections.Counter(x['status'] for x in d['packets']), d['connection']['state'], len(d['streams']))
EOF
